Commentary.Commentary: So the target for Canada is 155 runs. Do join us for the chase in a short while. Will Canada win this or will the hosts win it for their home fans here? Join us after this short break!

Muhammad Usman, the main man for UAE, is down for a quick interview. He says that after they were 3 down in the Powerplay, he remembered what his coach told him about how to slow down at the start and then after facing some balls pick up the pace of the innings. On being asked about his strategy at hitting towards the longer boundary, Usman says that his only strategy was to pick the gaps and hit through them.

For Canada, it all started really well with the ball. They dealt two blows early on. After that their spinners, Nikhil Dutta, Saad Bin Zafar and Junaid Siddiqui were brilliant in choking up the run flow. Up until then, the only negative for them was a dropped catch and poor bowling from Dillon Heyliger. However, Muhammad Usman turned on his style in the latter part of the innings. He along with the other batters scored 59 runs in the last 5 overs and have almost took the game away from Canada. Zafar was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up 3 wickets, while Dillon Heyliger was picked apart.

UAE started their innings poorly after being put into bat by Canada. They lost both their openers inside two overs. But from there on, Muhammad Usman and Rameez Shahzad stitched a small partnership of 42 runs to bring UAE back on track. After the departure of Shahzad, Usman and D'Silva got into the act as they stitched a 73-run stand. In the process, Usman reached his half ton too.  His counter-attacking batting took UAE to a very competitive total.

A bye to finish! Good length ball around off, Usman looks to paddle sweep but misses to get any bat on the ball. The non-striker calls for a bye and gets it as the keeper misses the target with his under arm throw. Usman finishes with 89 off 63 balls. An excellent innings that takes UAE's TOTAL TO 154/5.
Play and a miss this time. Good length ball outside off, Mohammad throws his bat at it but misses.
SIX! Wallop! Length ball on middle, Usman whacks it over the deep mid-wicket fence. The six takes the total over 150 for UAE.
Length ball outside off, Usman drives it towards deep point and scampers back for the second.
A dot, its a golddust at this moment in time. Length ball outside off, Usman looks to slam it through the off side but misses to put any bat on the ball.

FOUR! Another one! Innovation at its best. Usman is playing a gem of an innings here. Full ball outside off, Usman reads the delivery well ahead as he turns and scoops this one wide of the short fine leg fielder.
Dillon Heyliger to bowl the final over of the UAE innings. 3-0-35-0 are his figures so far.
SIX! Whacked! What a superb shot this one from Waheed. Full and in the slot, Waheed gets down on one knee and deposits it sailing over the deep mid-wicket fence. Cracking sound on that one.

EDGY FOUR! But the batsman will take take. A full ball outside off, Ahmed throws the kitchen sink at it and the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the third man fence, beating the diving gully fielder.
Back of a length ball again, Usman pulls this towards the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Muscled away! Full ball in the slot for Usman this time. He is in perfect positon to hammer this ball over the bowler's head and into the fence. Excellent batting.
Back of a length ball on middle, Usman looks to pull but gets an top edge on that. The ball falls in no man's land and the batters take a couple this time.
Swing and a miss! Fullish length ball outside off, Usman comes down the track and goes for the hoick but fails to put any bat on ball.
Fuller ball outside off, Usman guides it towards short third man for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
No hat-trick then. A quicker one outside off, tapped through point for a single.
Waheed Ahmed comes out to bat. He will be facing the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Good catch. Two in two for Bin Zafar. Nitish Kumar takes an excellent catch running forward. A golden duck for Sultan Ahmed. Saad fires another full ball outside off, Ahmed looks to play an inside out drive but gets an outside edge. The ball goes high in the air towards long off. Nitish Kumar there takes a fine tumbling catch to send the batsman packing.
Sultan Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! Stumping, and a sharp one from Tariq behind the wicket. D'Silva's struggle is over. Saad saw the batter skip down the track. He then fires the ball full and outside off, Tariq gets low, collects the ball, and whips the bails in a flash. He appeals and the umpire agrees.
Full ball around off, D'Silva looks to slog it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads. A dot.
Saad Bin Zafar to bowl his final over.
Good length ball, a slower one. Usman reads that well and turns it towards mid-wicket and picks up another couple. Brilliant bit of running form the pair in this innings.
Length outside off, D'Silva drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Full ball on the pads again, Usman flicks it nicely through mid-wicket, but just a single.
Another ball on the fifth stump line, D'Silva this time reaches out to the ball and taps it through point for a single.
WIDE! Go and reload! Eranga fires this way outside off to stay away from getting hammered. Too wide.
Fuller ball around off, Usman drives it through extra cover for a single.
Full ball on middle, Usman chips it gently towards left of long for a couple.
Romesh Eranga comes back on. 2-0-8-1 are his figures so far.

FOUR! Hammered it towards the longest part of the ground, deep mid-wicket. Full ball in the slot for D'Silva, he smacks it towards the deep mid-wicket fence uppishly. First boundary for D'Silva. 17 runs form the over.
Around off, Usman this time drives it through cover-point and takes a run.
Outside off this time, Usman crunches the cut through point for a couple.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished by Usman. Excellent batting. Short of a length ball down the leg side. Usman smacks it past the short fine leg fielder and into the fence.
On middle, Usman pushes it back to the bowler.

SIX! He has picked the bones out of that one. What a shot to get to his half century. Just short of a good length delivery on middle, Usman stays on the back foot and hammers this over the deep mid-wicket fence. What a superb shot. This should be move on for UAE.
Full around off, Usman eases this for a single through mid off.
FOUR! Wow! We finally have a boundary then. Full ball outside off, Usman comes down the track and plays a nice inside out drive over cover.
On the pads on a fullish length, Usman this time flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and gets a couple. The fielder there does well to keep the ball inside the rope with a diving effort.
Around off, D'Silva eases a single through mid off.
On middle, D'Silva looks to tuck it towards the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
Full ball on middle, Usman comes down the track and pushes this through mid on for a single.
Saad Bin Zafar is on now. 2-0-9-1 are his figures so far.
On the pads, D'Silva tucks it behind square and takes a quick single. A poor throw from deep square means the batters return back for a couple.

Dropped! Poor effort this one. No boundaries for UAE but Canda have not managed to get any wicket either for quite sometime now. They had a chance this time but Kirton makes a mess of an easy chance. A shortish length ball on middle, Usman pulls but the ball goes straight to Kirton at deep square leg who spills easiest of chances.
On the hips from Heyliger, Usman once again works it towards the leg side and hares back for a couple.
Shortish length again, tapped towards point for a single.

Short ball on middle, D'Silva this time gets on top of the delivery and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Ravinderpal Singh from deep mid-wicket runs to his left and keeps the ball in the play. A couple of runs taken.
Good length ball around off, D'Silva pushes it straight to the cover fielder.
Dillon Heyliger comes back on. 1*-0-10-0 are his figures so far.
Fuller around off, driven towards cover where the fielder does well to not allow any run.

Flatter ball outside off, Usman taps it left of deep cover fielder and hares back for another cover. While the boundaries have been tough, Usman has kept the scorecard ticking with excellent running between the wicket.
On the pads this time, tucked for a single through mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, Usman this time drives it through covers.

On the pads this time, going down too. Usman looks to paddle sweep hard at the ball but can't make the proper connection. The ball goes towards short fine leg and stops well before the boundary rope. Usman is livid with himself as he could only manage two runs off this poor ball.
On middle, D'Silva eases another single through mid off.

Loopy ball on the pads, D'Silva tucks it behind square leg and takes a run. He wanted the second but decides against it after seeing the fielder haring at the ball. It's been 36 balls since the last boundary.
On middle, D'Silva comes forward to block it out.
On middle and fullish length, nudged away towards mid on for a single.
Around off, D'Silva turns the ball towards mid on for a run.
Outside off this time, Usman taps it through cover-point and crosses end.
Fuller ball on middle, Darius flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Brilliant running! Excellent cricket from Usman this. He gets another loopy ball on middle, he gently tucks it towards mid-wicket and scampers back for two. 8 runs from the over.
Shorter and outside off, Usman gets another couple as he punches this ball through the mid off region.
On the pads and a flighted ball too. Usman flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and picks another couple.
Around off, pushed towards cover-point.
On the middle stump line this time, D'Silva tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, Usman pushes it towards cover and changes end.
Around off, Usman this time eases a single through mid off.
Slower through the air but on the hips, Usman flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a couple.
Fuller around off, driven through covers for a run.
Short and wide again, D'Silva punches it off the back foot but straight to the point fielder.
On middle this time, pushed back to the right of the bowler.
Starts with a flatter ball outside off, punched towards point for a single.
Junaid Siddiqui comes back on.
Dutta gives some air to it and Usman drives it through covers for a single.
D'Silva punches this fuller one through covers for a single.
D'Silva is happy to defend this flighted ball to the off side.
Usman lofts this fuller one  over mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on the pads, Usman works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Usman defends this flighted one to mid on.
Short and outside off, D'Silva cuts it to point.
Fuller one on off, D'Silva pushes it back to the bowler.
D'Silva defends this flighted one to the off side.
Darius D'Silva is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Where was the impact? Nevertheless, Shahzad has to walk back as there is no technology to challenge the on field decision. Zafar gives this one more air and lands it around off, Shahzad looks to defend this one only to get beaten on the spin. As soon as the ball hits the pad, UAE players went in appeal and the umpire raises his finger to give the marching orders to Shahzad.
Once again Zafar gives this one more air and Shahzad defends it to covers.
Zafar bowls one outside off, Shahzad drives it straight to the man at covers.
The batsman has punched the ball off the backfoot. One run added to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Short one on middle, Shahzad pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
This time Shahzad plays the sweep through square leg for a couple.
Usman flicks this fuller ball off his pads to mid-wicket for a run.
Shahzad plays this tossed up one to long on for a single.
Nikhil Dutta is on now.
Usman defends this tossed up ball to covers.
FOUR! Confident inside out shot. Usman just lofts this tossed up ball outisde off over the cover fielder. The ball goes onto cross the extra cover fence with ease.
Flighted one on the pads, Shahzad flicks it to mid-wicket . But there is no timing on that one so the ball stops inside the ropes. The batsmen take three.
Shahzad defends this flighted ball to the off side.
Tossed up on off, Usman charges down the track to get it of the inside half to the mid on for a single.
The batsman charges down the wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Saad Bin Zafar comes on now.
Usman defends this length ball to the off side to see off the over.
Shahzad flicks this length ball to the leg side for a single.

FOUR! How did that reach the fence? Heyliger goes short and Shahzad looks to pull it to the leg side. But gets a glove on it. The ball goes past the bowler and also beats the dive of mid on fielder to race to the long on fence.
Once again Dillon bowls on the pads, Shahzad flicks it to short fine leg fielder.
Length and on pads, Usman plays it towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
FOUR! Usman welcomes Heyliger with a boundary. Heyliger goes full on the pads, Usman flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Dillon Heyliger comes on now.
FOUR! Second one off the over. Siddiqui offers width on this flighted ball and Shahzad dances down the track to drive it past mid off for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Usman drives it to long off for a single.
Usman once again pushes this flighted ball to covers.
Usman defends this tossed up ball to the off side.
Once again a short delivery on middle this time. Shahzad pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Short and well outside off, Shahzad cuts it  through point for a boundary.
The ball has been square driven by the batsman.
Usman looks to cut this length ball outside off. But gets beaten off the outside edge. The keeper appeals but the umpire is uninterested.
Usman once again defends this length ball off the back foot to the off side.
Usman defends this length ball off the back foot.
Length and on off, Shahzad flicks it to mid-wicket  for a run.
Length and on off, Usman looks to defend it but gets an edge that runs to third man for a single.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground. One run added to the total.
WIDE! Siddiqui goes short and down the leg side. Shahzad looks to pull but fails to lay bat on ball. Wide signalled.
Flighted on the pads, Usman flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground. One run added to the total.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Muhammad Usman is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Both the openers have been sent packing here. Suri this time pulls this shorter one from Siddigui through mid-wicket but fails to get it completely off the bat. The ball goes high up in the air for the mid-wicket fielder to take an easy grab.
Junaid Siddiqui to bowl from the other end.
Shahzad drives this square of the wicket through the off side and takes a couple.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Shahzad this time shoulders arms to the one pitching on  a length and outside off.
WIDE! This time Eranga goes wide of off stump. Shahzad goes to chase it  but the line is way outside off. Wide signalled.
WIDE! Eranga bowls one down the leg side. Wide signalled.
Rameez Shahzad walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED! What a start for Canada. Eranga keeps it in the channel of uncertainity. Mustafa is stuck to his crease as he is confused a bit on the type of shot to play. The ball sneaks past the outside edge and hits the top of off stump.
Length and on off, Mustafa looks to run that down to third man but gets beaten.
WIDE! Eranga strays in line and bowls one down the leg side. Wide signalled.
Length and on off, Suri plays it to point and takes a quick single. Canada off the mark here.
We are all set to begin. Rohan Mustafa and Chirag Suri will open the batting for UAE. Romesh Eranga will start the proceedings for Canada with the ball.
UAE (Playing XI) - Rohan Mustafa, Rameez Shahzad, Chirag Suri, Muhammad Usman, Waheed Ahmed, Mohammad Boota (WK), Sultan Ahmed, Ahmed Raza (C), Darius D'Silva, Junaid Siddique, Zahoor Khan.

Canada (Playing XI) -  Srimantha Wijeratne, Navneet Dhaliwal (C), Nitish Kumar, Nicholas Kirton, Ravinderpal Singh, Saad Bin Zafar, Hamza Tariq (WK), Dillon Heyliger, Nikhil Dutta, Junaid Siddiqui, Romesh Eranga.
TOSS - It's toss time. Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Canada. CANADA ELECT TO FIELD.

Welcome to the last fixture of the group stage of the ICC World T20 Qualifiers. Its the hosts UAE taking on Canada. Third-placed UAE are already qualified for the playoffs. Whereas, Canada are reeling at the fifth spot after a series of losses. A win here for UAE will be a morale booster before the playoffs. On the other hand, Canada needs to win this game today to grab the fourth spot and get qualified for the playoffs. A loss here for the Canadians will see their hopes of appearing at the World T20 in 2020 in Australia get shattered. Stay tuned for the toss in a while.
